d:
Inside the home of two girls, there is a parasite waiting outside stalking them. As soon as the girls are separated, the parasite invader moves inside and ambush the unsuspecting victim. The parasite enters her mouth and corrupts her mind... turning her body against her will then use it to capture more prey.
